snippet.title: Ripperdoc  Simulator - Steam Announcement Teaser #game #steam #simulator
snippet.description:
Wishlist Ripperdoc Simulator on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937940/Ripperdoc_Simulator
In Ripperdoc Simulator, you are the surgeon of the shadows. In the front, you run a dingy electronics shop in a crime-ridden district. In the back, you perform illegal implantations on desperate clients seeking power, beauty, or survival — no matter the cost.

Coming in 2025!
